text: Rediscovering India's architectural memory through AI
Digital revitalisation of unstructured cultural and architectural heritage archives

Project brief: HackCult '26 Problem Statement 2. Cover image: Konark Sun Temple asset from the HeritageLens licensed image library. Photography attribution is recorded in frontend/public/images/sites/ATTRIBUTION.md.
Heritage knowledge lives in disconnected formats
Photographs, PDFs, field journals and regional-language scans cannot be searched as one archive.

Discovery slows down.
Context breaks.
Fragile sources stay hidden.
Researchers cannot trace evidence across collections without manually reopening every source.
Problem framing supplied by the user and reflected in the HeritageLens project README. Images come from the project image library and its recorded attributions.
One archive connects source files to cultural context
HeritageLens turns unstructured evidence into records people can browse, search and verify.
Upload a PDF, photograph or manuscript scan
Extract text, capture metadata and preserve the original
Explore sites, documents, maps and grounded answers
Browsing, filters, map and document search remain open to everyone.
Authenticated upload, review, correction and archive maintenance.
Verified in frontend routes, backend routers and browser acceptance tests. Public reads remain open; modifying APIs require curator authentication.

Automation handles extraction. A curator controls what enters the searchable archive.

Current search implementation verified in backend/app/routers/search.py and Alembic migration 0004. Assistant provider and grounded fallback verified in backend/app/services/assistant.py. Embeddings, hybrid semantic retrieval and formal RAG evaluation are planned, not implemented.
The current architecture favors tested boundaries and reversible deployment decisions.
Protected write APIs, explicit processing states, audit trail, migration-managed schema

Local results: 39 backend tests and 3 Playwright workflows passed.
A living digital record of India's architectural memory
HeritageLens gives every source a durable place, searchable context and a path back to evidence.
Find connected evidence across sites and documents
Preserve originals while correcting machine-extracted text
Publish structured collections through a maintainable system
Explore monuments through maps and accessible narratives
Technology should help cultural memory remain discoverable, verifiable and alive.
